SELECT NVL(SUM(AMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT WHERE STATUS IN ('PAID', 'PARTIAL_REFUNDED')
AND PAID_AT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOOKING WHERE STATUS = 'CONFIRMED'
AND CREATED_AT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')

SELECT DEP.IATA_CODE || ' → ' || ARR.IATA_CODE AS routeName, NVL(SUM(P.AMOUNT), 0) AS routeRevenue FROM PAYMENT P JOIN BOOKING B ON P.BOOKING_ID = B.BOOKING_ID JOIN FLIGHT F ON B.OUTBOUND_FLIGHT_ID = F.FLIGHT_ID JOIN ROUTE RT ON F.ROUTE_ID = RT.ROUTE_ID JOIN AIRPORT DEP ON RT.DEPARTURE_AIRPORT_ID = DEP.AIRPORT_ID JOIN AIRPORT ARR ON RT.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_ID = ARR.AIRPORT_ID WHERE P.STATUS IN ('PAID', 'PARTIAL_REFUNDED')
AND P.PAID_AT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
GROUP BY DEP.IATA_CODE, ARR.IATA_CODE ORDER BY routeRevenue DESC

SELECT DEP.IATA_CODE || ' → ' || ARR.IATA_CODE AS routeName, COUNT(*) AS routeBookings FROM BOOKING B JOIN FLIGHT F ON B.OUTBOUND_FLIGHT_ID = F.FLIGHT_ID JOIN ROUTE RT ON F.ROUTE_ID = RT.ROUTE_ID JOIN AIRPORT DEP ON RT.DEPARTURE_AIRPORT_ID = DEP.AIRPORT_ID JOIN AIRPORT ARR ON RT.ARRIVAL_AIRPORT_ID = ARR.AIRPORT_ID WHERE B.STATUS = 'CONFIRMED'
AND B.CREATED_AT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
GROUP BY DEP.IATA_CODE, ARR.IATA_CODE ORDER BY routeBookings DESC
